sloka: यादृशानि तु दृश्यन्ते लङ्कायामशुभानि तु ।अचिरेणैव कालेन भविष्यति हतप्रभा ।। ५.२४.२६।।।।
transliteration: yādṛśāni tu dṛśyante laṅkāyāmaśubhāni tu ।acireṇaiva kālena bhaviṣyati hataprabhā ।। 5.24.26।।।।

translations.english: O beautiful Sita Just like Swaha, queen to the Firegod and Sachi to Indra, accept Ravana. Why are you still thinking of Rama who is helpless and whose life span is coming to an end soon.
